ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Needed so you can unlock the app with Face ID.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Needed to read your daily step count from Apple Health and show it with your coach. Only your step count is read; nothing is written to Health.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: PulseCoach does not write any data to Apple Health; it only reads your daily step count. This permission is never requested.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Needed to choose a meal photo and send it for nutrition analysis.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Needed to take a meal photo and send it for nutrition analysis.
